content: tinytable 0.18.0 (CRAN, 2026-08-20): zero hard dependencies (imports only 'methods'). Supports HTML, LaTeX, Markdown, Word, PNG, PDF, Typst. R >= 4.1.0. 21 packages in Suggests all optional. Bootstrap for HTML, tabularray for LaTeX. Human-readable output files easy to edit. Minimal API surface easy to learn. Best choice for R package Suggests dependency: avoids dependency chains, no breaking change risk from upstream packages. Designed specifically with package developers in mind.
